question: If (x)/(y)=cot θ where θ is an acute angle, then cosec θ = _______.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the fundamental trigonometric identity:

⇒ cosec² θ = 1 + cot² θ

⇒ cosec θ = √(1 + (x/y)²) = √((y² + x²) / y²)

⇒ cosec θ = (√(x² + y²)) / y

**∴ The correct answer is (√(x²+y²))/(y).**
